summary: A certification for companies located in Tønder Municipality demonstrating social responsibility by employing a minimum share of employees through schemes such as small jobs, business internships, special employment conditions, and adult apprentices or students. Certified companies receive a CSR package including a logo for commercial use and support for the UN Sustainable Development Goal 8 concerning decent work and economic growth.
eligible_applicants: Small companies up to 50 employees with minimum 10% of workforce in relevant employment schemes
Large companies with 50+ employees with minimum 5 employees in relevant schemes
activity_types: Employment of inclusive workforce under small jobs
Special employment conditions such as sheltered jobs, flexible jobs, wage subsidies
reporting_requirements: Maintain and document employment share in relevant inclusion schemes during the current year
